insp.label: Data sources · raw data
insp.dragWidth: Drag to change the width · double-click: original size
insp.dragHeight: Drag to change the height · double-click: original size
insp.dragBoth: Drag: width and height · double-click: original size
insp.empty: No data has been loaded on this page yet.
insp.rawHint: Pick a source above (top right) to see its raw data.
insp.tilesHint: Drag · mouse wheel zooms · click picks a tile
insp.galleryHint: {n} images · click shows the image large
insp.truncated: Very large response: only the first {a} of {b} were loaded, so no tree.
insp.clearedPage: Data sources of this page cleared
insp.errVia: The request went through the data proxy: whether the proxy or the API behind it failed, the browser cannot tell.
insp.errTimeout: The page gave up after a fixed time (timeout), no answer arrived.
insp.errAborted2: The page ended the request itself – usually because a newer request replaced it, a timeout fired or the view changed. An answer from the server was no longer read.
insp.errTypeError: No answer arrived: server unreachable, no connection, blocked by CORS or dropped by an ad blocker. For security reasons the browser hardly ever names the exact reason.
insp.noOwnHeaders: no own headers – the browser adds its standard headers.
insp.browserLoaded: Loaded by the browser itself (image, texture …): headers and body cannot be inspected.
